as_told.title: Salas learns in 1996 he was at Oscar, not Echo Flight

plain: A former Air Force officer named Robert Salas says that in 1967 a UFO shut down nuclear missiles in Montana, and that his commander that night, Fred Maywald, later confirmed the story on a recorded call. Salas tells Michels he only reached Maywald in 1996, and that the call taught him he had been at Oscar Flight, one group of missile sites, rather than Echo Flight, another. He says Maywald 'verified the essentials of the story,' and the recording is posted on the website spiralgalaxy.org.
